News feed product UX vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume news capability in the binary covers storefront language. Connect and iOS actually separate in-app article browsing from product-page copy:

  • Feed ingestion & article rendering — your app fetches headlines, parses RSS or publisher APIs, and renders story layouts. Controls what buyers see after install — not App Store language. AppLocale does not implement this.
  • NewsKit, push alerts & channel sync — publisher identifiers, breaking-news push payloads, and Following subscription state. Engineering work, not Connect metadata.
  • In-app news UI — channel picker labels, Today tab titles, and article chrome on your screens. Your listing may mention Today feed; implementing feed logic is engineering, not listing copy.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of news features in the binary.

A working Today feed in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

What China buyers see when zh-Hans news copy is missing

News-conscious purchasers browsing the China App Store evaluate headline clarity in the first scroll. Common failure modes when only en-US is filled:

  • English title and subtitle — app name and tagline still Latin script while competitors show native Chinese news positioning
  • Untranslated Today badges on screenshots — overlay lines like "Today", "News+", "Channels", "Following", "Breaking news", or "Top stories" remain English on zh-Hans gallery frames
  • Channel value in English — description opens with US news marketing ("Follow the topics you care about") that China readers skim past or misread
  • Keyword field still en-US — buyers search 新闻, 新闻应用, 今日, 频道, or 关注; an English-only keyword row misses China Search intent for news reader China App Store queries
  • Mixed page — Chinese description pasted once but screenshot captions and subtitle still English — reads unfinished next to localized news competitors
  • Formal machine translation — stiff 翻译腔 for "Following" (关注 vs 订阅) and wrong News+ phrasing (新闻+ vs 新闻会员 context) that does not match how Chinese buyers read store pages

Better zh-Hans listing copy helps news-conscious buyers understand Today feed and channel value before install. It does not replace feed implementation, publisher partnerships, or Apple's review decisions.

News-specific listing copy — what translates differently

News-app listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe news readers — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Today vs channels vs Following

US pages mix "Today", "Top stories", "Channels", and "Following" in one gallery. China storefront copy often separates 今日 (Today tab), 频道 (channel browse), and 关注 (Following/saved publishers) — depending on which frame you show. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your actual feature set, not inventing News+ or channel capabilities your app does not support.

News+ and premium tiers

Many indie news apps market a News+ style subscriber tier — exclusive channels, ad-free reading, or premium headlines. Chinese buyers expect concrete labels (新闻会员, 订阅频道, 无广告阅读) on screenshot overlays rather than English slogans ("Unlock every story", "Go premium") that hide what the screen actually shows. IAP display names are a separate Connect task — see IAP localization (zh-Hans) when paywall product names need zh-Hans too.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need news-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 新闻, 新闻应用, and 今日 each signal different intent from generic media keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Today" headlines on gallery frames — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

Common mistakes on news zh-Hans listings

  • Assuming news UI localizes automatically — Today feed and channel browse shipped; zh-Hans row never added or left blank
  • Only translating the description — subtitle, keywords, and screenshot caption lines still English
  • Reusing US Today badges verbatim — Latin "News+" or "Following" badges on zh-Hans screenshots signal unfinished localization
  • Conflating news with Safari — Reader mode and browser-tab marketing belongs on the Safari guide, not Today feed or channel copy
  • Mixing up news with Podcasts — episode playback and lock-screen audio captions localized but Today feed story still English on subtitle and description
  • Expecting AppLocale to implement NewsKit — feed parsers, publisher APIs, and article rendering are outside listing rewrite
  • Ignoring caption fields per localization — zh-Hans screenshot set uploaded but overlay text fields never saved; see Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese
